messages:
tariq: Heads-up — pool-gamma reporting GPU steal ~18% last 20m, request SLO errors spiking. Noticed network egress bursts around 13:40 UTC. Anyone on this?

infra-bot: [ALERT] pool-gamma GPU-steal-high triggered at 2026-03-18T13:44Z — AlertID: PGL-9823

maria: Looking. Pulling telemetry, will share top tenants by tokens/sec in a sec.

alex: Can you paste the prometheus query you used?

maria: ```
sum by(tenant) (rate(gpu_steal_seconds_total{pool="pool-gamma"}[5m]))
```
Top tenants (5m): tenant_A (0.12), tenant_B (0.08), tenant_C (0.03)

jen: tenant_A is on shared pool + high-concurrency in prod. We throttled last week but didn't persist the change. Likely noisy neighbor.

sam: I also see a net burst in pod egress bytes at ~13:40 from nodes hosting tenant_A. Correlation looks strong.

tariq: Hypothesis: large egress bursts are causing host interrupts / kernel preemption -> GPU steal for colocated tenants. Our eviction scoring only considers mem/cpu, not net.

maria: Quick mitigation option: shift tenant_A to a dedicated-small for 1h to stop SLO noise. Cost vs downtime tradeoff.

ops-oncall: I can do the temporary shard move. ETA ~12m. Will create a canary rollout (canary=1) and monitor.

alex: Long term we should include net_saturation in eviction heuristics and add routing rules to auto-isolate sustained egressy tenants. Filing ticket INFRA-2789.

jen: Also propose a cheaper short-term control: apply per-tenant qdisc using BPF to cap bursty egress instead of moving to dedicated. Less cost but more infra work.

maria: I'll try to reproduce locally using a recorded replay + `stress-ng --hog-io` variant. Opening a repro PR and test harness.

tariq: Ops, once moved paste the kube job and pod IDs here. If the move fails fallback to applying per-tenant rate-limiter.

ops-oncall: Done. Moved tenant_A -> cluster:dedi-small-42. Pod migration job: job/tenant-a-migrate-20260318-01. Pods: kube/pod-9876 -> kube/pod-9889. Monitoring now. :eyes: 

infra-bot: [RECOVERY] pool-gamma GPU-steal-normalized at 2026-03-18T13:57Z — AlertID: PGL-9823

sam: Confirmed steal dropped to ~2%. Latency alerts cleared. Nice work. :thumbsup: 

jen: Follow-ups: 1) INFRA-2789 add net_saturation to eviction scoring + weight tuning, 2) prototype per-tenant qdisc shaper, 3) cost analysis: top-5 noisy tenants -> dedicated vs shaping.

tariq: Assigning INFRA-2789 to alex (due EOW). Maria will lead repro PR and test harness. Ops-oncall to draft an oncall runbook for tenant moves + fallback.

maria: Adding notes to runbook and will paste doc link here when ready.

alex: I'll start the ticket write-up and include a short ML workload replay to validate heuristics.

ops-oncall: Runbook draft: short checklist + commands to move tenant, revert, and apply qdisc. Will share in ~2h.

jen: Thanks everyone. Let's also surface this in weekly eng-infra sync so product teams know this could impact cost models.

sam: FYI I'll add metric dashboards for net_saturation per-tenant so alerts can trigger earlier.

tariq: Thanks — closing for now, reopen if anything flares back up.
